name: Grade 1 English: Phonics - consonant sounds m, s, t
subject: English
subStrand: Phonics: consonant sounds m, s, t
learningObjectives: By the end of the lesson, the learner should be able to read and write the sounds m, s and t
By the end of the lesson, the learner should be able to blend simple words like 'mat', 'sat' and 'tap'
learningActivities: Sound drill: learners repeat the sounds m, s, t after the teacher
Blending: teacher models blending 'm-a-t' to read 'mat', learners practise in pairs
Word building: learners use letter cards to build words
Reading game: learners read word cards and match them to pictures
keyPoints: The letter 'm' has the sound /m/, 's' has /s/ and 't' has /t/
Blending sounds together forms words: m-a-t makes 'mat'
Reading from left to right is important
commonMisconceptions: Sounding out each letter in isolation without blending
Reversing letter order when writing words
lessonEvaluation: Learners blend and read the words mat, sat, tap and write them. Teacher checks each learner.
teacherReflection: Blending needs more practice. Next lesson: continue with two-letter blends.
